notes:
Read-along keeps its voice.

Every line used to be spoken once and thrown away, so the app made the sound again the next time you read the page — and the first time, it made it while you waited. Narration audio is now kept.

• Re-reading a page, or picking a chapter back up, starts almost instantly instead of pausing first. Measured on a test device: 3.3 seconds down to 0.16 seconds before the first word.
• While you listen, the app quietly makes the audio for the pages ahead, so it is ready before you get there.
• It only ever works ahead in the gaps where the voice is already busy — it will never make you wait to get ahead.

Kept audio lives in the app's cache, so your phone can reclaim it if space runs short, and it never touches your library or reading progress.
